display_unit.title: Display Unit
display_unit.description: Unit shown in the Move and Resize boxes. The model and MCP always use millimetres.

sticky_selection.title: Sticky Selection
sticky_selection.description: Clicking empty space keeps the selection.

screen.title: Screen
screen.description: start = the Welcome screen with recent files; scene = the 3D workspace.

open.title: Open
open.description: Whether the command row under the tabs is showing.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the button can be used right now.

commands.title: Commands
commands.description: In the order the ribbon shows them.

sharpness.description: How narrow and deep the groove is at the stroke line, like the desktop Crease Sharpness slider: 0 is the gentle crease, 1 the sharpest. The surface never folds.
sharpness.title: Sharpness

percent.description: Remove about this percentage of the faces, like the desktop Simplify slider (10 per notch); stops early rather than change the shape. Use instead of face_count.
percent.title: Percent

mode.description: whole: the whole object (desktop Whole object). area: only face_indices, or the faces within radius_mm of the centers_mm path (desktop Area I brush over); the area's edge stays joined to the rest. Both need percent.
mode.title: Mode

mode.description: whole: cut every face into four even triangles (desktop Whole object). area: cut only face_indices, or the faces within radius_mm of the centers_mm path (desktop Area I brush over). Leave out for the original doubling.
mode.title: Mode

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Paint coverage 0..1. 1 paints the whole object; lower values paint the region around face that shares its direction.

face.title: Face
face.description: Clicked face index; required when coverage is below 1.

faces.title: Faces
faces.description: Exact face indices to paint instead of a coverage region.

path.title: Path
path.description: Picture file (PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TGA, TIFF or WebP) under an approved root. Omit to change only the repeat size of the objects' current texture.

tile_mm.title: Tile Mm
tile_mm.description: The picture repeats every tile_mm millimetres on every side.

from_point_mm.title: From Point Mm
from_point_mm.description: World point [x, y, z] in millimetres where the ruler starts. Give a point or an object for this end, not both.

from_object_id.description: Object whose nearest surface point the ruler starts at (nearest to the other end).
from_object_id.title: From Object Id

from_index.description: Top-level object index, as an alternative to from_object_id.
from_index.title: From Index

to_point_mm.title: To Point Mm
to_point_mm.description: World point [x, y, z] in millimetres where the ruler ends. Give a point or an object for this end, not both.

to_object_id.description: Object whose nearest surface point the ruler ends at (nearest to the other end).
to_object_id.title: To Object Id

to_index.description: Top-level object index, as an alternative to to_object_id.
to_index.title: To Index

input_schema.title: measureArguments
input_schema.description: Measure the straight distance between two ends, like the desktop Measure ruler. Each end is a point or an object; an object end is the point on its surface nearest the other end (two objects: their closest surface points, 0 when they touch). Read-only; never changes the scene.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Light or dark look, as the top-bar toggle and Settings set it.

size.title: Size
size.description: Normal, or Big (everything twice the size).

display_unit.title: Display Unit
display_unit.description: Unit shown in the Move and Resize boxes; values given to MCP stay millimetres.

default_import_unit.title: Default Import Unit
default_import_unit.description: Unit assumed for imported files that do not say.

sticky_selection.title: Sticky Selection
sticky_selection.description: Keep the selection when empty space is clicked.

resize_basis.title: Resize Basis
resize_basis.description: Resize along the grid axes or the object's own axes.

keep_proportions.title: Keep Proportions
keep_proportions.description: Resize boxes change all three sizes together.

screen_aligned.title: Screen Aligned
screen_aligned.description: Keep the key light fixed on the screen as the view turns.

azimuth_degrees.title: Azimuth Degrees
azimuth_degrees.description: Light angle across the screen; positive is to the left.

lighting.title: Lighting
lighting.description: Viewport light, highlight and floor shadow, as in Settings. Give only the values to change.

reset_lighting.title: Reset Lighting
reset_lighting.description: Put the lighting back to its defaults first.

slicer.title: Slicer
slicer.description: Save this slicer for the Slicer button and launch_slicer: a key or path from discover_slicers.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.description: The whole favorites strip, in order, as 'Tab:Label' keys (see app_settings).

add_favorite.title: Add Favorite
add_favorite.description: Append one 'Tab:Label' key to the favorites strip.

remove_favorite.title: Remove Favorite
remove_favorite.description: Remove one 'Tab:Label' key from the favorites strip.

tab.title: Tab
tab.description: The tab whose command order tab_order sets or reset='tab_order' resets.

tab_order.title: Tab Order
tab_order.description: Command labels of tab in the new order; labels left out follow in their default order.

reset.title: Reset
reset.description: favorites = default strip; tab_order = default order of tab; all = both, every tab.

screen.title: Screen
screen.description: start = Welcome screen with recent files (the scene is kept); scene = the 3D workspace; settings / about open those windows.

ribbon_tab.title: Ribbon Tab
ribbon_tab.description: Show this ribbon tab (and open the command row).

ribbon_open.title: Ribbon Open
ribbon_open.description: Open or fold the command row under the tabs (a pinned row stays open).

action.title: Action
action.description: list, remove one entry, or clear the list. Files on disk are never touched.

path.title: Path
path.description: Entry to remove, by its listed path.

path.title: Path
path.description: Entry to open, by its listed path.

path.title: Path
path.description: PNG file to write, inside an approved folder.

if_unsaved.title: If Unsaved
if_unsaved.description: With unsaved changes: refuse (default; call save_project first), ask (show the desktop's save prompt to the user), or discard them.
